_comment: Which orgs a person is OFFERED to pick from (feature-local-example-first-run, item 6). ONE table, two readers: Tests/Test-Config.ps1 runs Scripts/Select-OfferedSpaces.ps1 over it, Tests/test_offered_orgs.py runs agent/core/config.py's offered_orgs. Each row is one org: dismissed is isDemoDismissed, example is the org's own example flag, active is whether it is the active Space. If the halves ever disagree about a row, one of them is wrong.

rows.why: not dismissed: an ordinary org is offered
not dismissed: the Example org is offered too
not dismissed: the active Space is offered
dismissed: an ordinary org is untouched
dismissed: the Example org is left out
dismissed: the active ordinary org is offered
dismissed, but you are IN Example: never hide where you are
